roles.name: Toolchain Validator
roles.description: Runs development-toolchain-validator (or manual fallback: scenario-auditor + test-genie + tidiness-manager) against a gold-star reference scenario each heartbeat; investigates violations the tool returns. No visited tracker needed — the tool surfaces current issues.

roles.name: Skill Optimizer
roles.description: Identifies high-usage skills and pushes deterministic execution toward Actions over Vrooli-controlled CLIs. Also audits skill and Action drift and proposes deprecation of unused skills or obsolete Actions.

roles.name: Team & Agent Optimizer
roles.description: Audits team structures and agent files together (they co-evolve). Maintains team-audit and agent-audit artifacts, proposes structural/prompt changes, and proposes deprecation of unused agents or empty teams.

roles.name: Run Introspector
roles.description: Inspects recent agent-manager runs since last heartbeat (errored → retried → slow → random-success triage). Captures lessons and proposes skill/agent/prompt changes grounded in what actually happened in execution, not what's documented.

roles.name: Contrarian
roles.description: Mandatory skeptic across all other members' proposals. Defends against polishing, sprawl, premature conversion, churn-without-benefit, too-fast deprecation, scope creep, and conversion-without-measurement. Owns the aging scan for the decision queue.

roles.name: Debt Curator
roles.description: Applies the team's own evolutionary-pressure principles to itself. Scans docs/meta-optimization/ for prose workarounds that have stabilized into promotable patterns; proposes promotion into permanent structure (skills, scenario features, team-config changes) or retirement when already obsoleted. Proposes only — never implements.
